This is a stronger claim than the projection could support if it ever drifted from the knowledge layer.

negative_case_audit.scenario_analyzed: A tap-type application note's `source` field is changed in the knowledge layer (or the projection is hand-edited) while `fact` and `status` remain identical.

All other validators either don't touch application_notes at all, or (T11's check 8) only compare the PROJECTION against RENDERED HTML, never the KNOWLEDGE LAYER against the PROJECTION.

selected_t15_target.title: Tap-Type Application-Note Source Preservation Verification
selected_t15_target.objective: Extend validate-tapping-projections.js's existing check 9 (Application-Note Completeness) to actually verify what its own comment already claims: that each application note's `source` field is preserved unchanged between the knowledge-layer entity and the tap-type projection.
selected_t15_target.root_risk: Check 9 verifies fact-presence, duplication, and status, but never compares `source`. A knowledge-layer edit, a future generator bug, or a hand-edited projection could substitute a fabricated or stale citation for any of the 16 tap-type facts while every current validator, including this one, continues to pass.
selected_t15_target.affected_consumer: data/projections/tapping/tap-types.json rows' classification arrays' .source field; indirectly reference/tap-type-guide.html and reference/tapping-evidence.html, both of which render this field as a citation
selected_t15_target.exact_gap: no comparison of projected[0].source against note.source
selected_t15_target.validator_behavior_required: Inside check 9's existing per-note loop, after the existing status comparison, add: else if (projected[0].source !== note.source) { push an error identifying the entity, fact, and both source values }.
selected_t15_target.mutation_test_required: Temporarily edit a real application note's `source` field in data/entities/entities.seed.json (backed up first) for one existing fact, without regenerating the projection; run the validator; confirm the extended check fails with the correct fact/entity identified; restore and confirm byte-identical checksum and pass.
selected_t15_target.false_positive_test_required: Run against the real, untouched knowledge layer and projection; must pass, 0 errors -- current data already agrees on source for all 16 facts.
selected_t15_target.regression_tests_required: All 9 existing tapping validators continue to pass; every checksum outside the validator itself (both projections, all 3 dataset files, all 4 product HTML files, the CSV, the client data file, entities.seed.json) remains byte-identical.
selected_t15_target.determinism_requirements: Validator run 3x on restored real data; identical report checksum every run.
forbidden_files: data/entities/entities.seed.json (except as a temporary, restored mutation fixture)
selected_t15_target.pass_criteria: 0 errors on real data; correct failure identifying the mutated entity/fact on the reproduced mismatch; everything else unaffected
